text: 1. Certificate photo (recent 2-inch bareheaded photo);2. Scanned copy of the first page of the passport (ordinary passport, valid after October 31, 2025);3. Passport visa page (required for students already in China);4. Notarized high school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate must be stamped with the official seal of the school:(1) Fresh high school graduates submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school,(2) senior high school students who have graduated submit their high school diploma;5. Scanned copy of notarized transcript:(1) Fresh high school graduates submit transcripts during the school years,(2) Students who have graduated from high school submit complete transcripts of high school;(3) High school test scores or internationally accepted standardized test scores, such as UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT, etc.;6. Proof of language proficiency within the validity period:Applicants for English-taught programs are required to submit TOEFL IBT or IELTS transcripts with a TOEFL IBT score of 80 or above and IELTS score of 5.5 or above. Applicants who have taken English as the language of instruction in senior high school may present a language of instruction certificate issued by the senior high school as a substitute;7.Medical examination form for foreigners8.Proof of no criminal record (within 6 months)9.Declaration of no history of drug use 10.Proof of financial ability: Deposit proof sufficient to cover reasonable expenses of study, living and international travel during the period of study in China (at least one semester's tuition fee should be held);11. Study plan: no less than 1000 words. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs should write in Chinese; applicants for English-taught programs should write in English;12. Students who have studied in China must provide proof of their studies in their original school;
